name: 79714 · Andrews, TX
findings: ZIP 79714 (Andrews) has 31 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (29%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 79714 (Andrews) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
67% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
